narr: A stationary front was draped across the area on June 22nd under a warm and moist airmass. PWAT values near 1.8 to 2 inches along with MUCAPE values of 1000 to 1500 J/kg allowed for the development of thunderstorms with heavy rainfall on the order of 1-2 per hour rates. Rainfall totals in southern Connecticut were anywhere from 1- 2 inches.
ev: Route 334 closed between Wakelee Avenue and Riggs Street due to a washout caused by flooding.
